name: Iterator
summary: Provides a way to access the elements of an aggregate object sequentially, without exposing its underlying representation.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Iterator
roles.summary: Declares the operations for traversing the elements.

roles.name: ConcreteIterator
roles.summary: Implements the traversal, and keeps track of the current position.

roles.name: Aggregate
roles.summary: Declares the operation that creates an iterator over its elements.

roles.name: ConcreteAggregate
roles.summary: Returns an iterator suited to its own representation.
